39911-the-army-mule-and-other-war-sketch.title: Humorous War Sketches
39911-the-army-mule-and-other-war-sketch.creator: Capt. Henry A. Castle
39911-the-army-mule-and-other-war-sketch.description: A book by Capt. Henry A. Castle. I hail thee Brother--spite of the fool's scorn! And fain would take thee with me, in the dell  Of peace and mild Equality to dwell,  Where Toil shall call the charmer Health his bride,  And Laughter tickle Plenty's ribless side! How thou wouldst toss thy heels in gamesome play,  And frisk about, as lamb or kitten gay!

arxiv-1605-06527.title: Generic freeness in frame bundle prolongations of C ∞ C^{\infty} actions
arxiv-1605-06527.creator: Scot Adams
arxiv-1605-06527.description: Abstract . Let a real Lie group G G act on a C ∞ C^{\infty} real manifold M M . Assume that the action is C ∞ C^{\infty} and that every nontrivial element of G G has a nowhere dense fixpoint set in M M .

arxiv-2402-17275.title: One-Shot Structure-Aware Stylized Image Synthesis
arxiv-2402-17275.creator: Hansam Cho, Jonghyun Lee, Seunggyu Chang, Yonghyun Jeong
arxiv-2402-17275.description: Abstract While GAN-based models have been successful in image stylization tasks, they often struggle with structure preservation while stylizing a wide range of input images. Recently, diffusion models have been adopted for image stylization but still lack the capability to maintain the original quality of input images.

arxiv-2410-19838.title: Non-invasive Neural Decoding in Source Reconstructed Brain Space
arxiv-2410-19838.creator: Yonatan Gideoni, Ryan Charles Timms, Oiwi Parker Jones
arxiv-2410-19838.description: Abstract Non-invasive brainwave decoding is usually done using Magneto/Electroencephalography (MEG/EEG) sensor measurements as inputs. This makes combining datasets and building models with inductive biases difficult as most datasets use different scanners and the sensor arrays have a nonintuitive spatial structure. In contrast, fMRI scans are acquired directly in brain space, a voxel grid with a typical structured input representation.

arxiv-2503-16180.title: BaZrS 3 {}_{\text{3}} Lights Up: The Interplay of Electrons, Photons, and Phonons in Strongly Luminescent Single Crystals
arxiv-2503-16180.creator: Rasmus Svejstrup Nielsen, Ángel Labordet Álvarez, Yvonne Tomm, Galina Gurieva, Andres Ortega-Guerrero, Joachim Breternitz, Lorenzo Bastonero, Nicola Marzari, Carlo Antonio Pignedoli, Susan Schorr, Mirjana Dimitrievska
arxiv-2503-16180.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rasmus Svejstrup Nielsen, Ángel Labordet Álvarez, Yvonne Tomm, Galina Gurieva, Andres Ortega-Guerrero, Joachim Breternitz, Lorenzo Bastonero, Nicola Marzari, Carlo Antonio Pignedoli, Susan Schorr, Mirjana Dimitrievska. Chalcogenide perovskites have emerged as a promising class of materials for the next generation of optoelectronic applications, with BaZrS 3 {}_{\text{3}} attracting significant attention due to its wide bandgap, earth-abundant composition, and thermal and chemical stability.

arxiv-2504-19476.title: Optimal Sequential Recommendations: Exploiting User and Item Structure
arxiv-2504-19476.creator: Mina Karzand, Guy Bresler
arxiv-2504-19476.description: Abstract We consider an online model for recommendation systems, with each user being recommended an item at each time-step and providing ’like’ or ’dislike’ feedback. A latent variable model specifies the user preferences: both users and items are clustered into types.

arxiv-2509-14175.title: Thermal-nonthermal transition of the charged particle production in pp collisions
arxiv-2509-14175.creator: J. Alonso Tlali, D. Rosales Herrera, J. R. Alvarado García, A. Fernández Téllez, C. Pajares, J. E. Ramírez
arxiv-2509-14175.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by J. Alonso Tlali, D. Rosales Herrera, J. R. Alvarado García, A. Fernández Téllez, C. Pajares, J. E. Ramírez. We determine the internal energy of charged particle production in minimum bias pp collisions using a thermostatistical approach by analyzing the p T p_{\text{T}} spectrum reported by the ALICE Collaboration across LHC energies.

arxiv-2512-04853.title: Pion physics with dressed quark-gluon vertices
arxiv-2512-04853.creator: M.N. Ferreira, A.S. Miramontes, J.M. Morgado, J. Papavassiliou, J.M. Pawlowski
arxiv-2512-04853.description: Abstract Recently, a theoretical framework was set up in Miramontes et al. 2025a , which allows for the symmetry-preserving inclusion of full quark-gluon vertices in the description of the meson dynamics. In the present work, we develop a special truncation within this approach, which leads to a tractable set of functional equations that satisfy the fundamental chiral Ward-Takahashi identities.

maastricht-treaty-1992-full.title: Maastricht Treaty
maastricht-treaty-1992-full.creator: European Union
maastricht-treaty-1992-full.description: The 1992 Treaty on European Union (Maastricht), founding the EU.

pmc-10663232.title: Transcriptome analysis in hepatopancreases reveals the response of domesticated common carp to a high-temperature environment in the agricultural heritage rice–fish system
pmc-10663232.creator: Xiangbing Cheng, Fangcheng Li, Gilbert Kumilamba, Jiayi Liao, Jiangwei Cao, Jiamin Sun, Qigen Liu
pmc-10663232.description: Qingtian paddy field carp (PF-carp) is a local carp cultivated in the paddy field of Qingtian, Zhejiang. This rice–fish co-culture system has been recognized as one of the Globally Important Agriculture Heritage Systems (GIAHS). PF-carp has been acclimatized to the high-temperature environment of shallow paddy fields after several centuries of domestication.

pmc-10670962.title: Unlocking the WHO’s Age-Friendly Healthcare Principles: Portugal’s Quest and Recommendations
pmc-10670962.creator: Jéssica Tavares, Gonçalo Santinha, Nelson Pacheco Rocha, Ann Liljas
pmc-10670962.description: Countries worldwide are grappling with a pressing demographic challenge characterized by a growing older population. This poses a significant healthcare dilemma, presenting challenges for healthcare systems and providers. To address these challenges, the World Health Organization (WHO) has devised a set of Age-Friendly Principles, aimed at optimizing healthcare provision for older people.

pmc-10671910.title: Comparative Genomic and Transcriptomic Analysis of Phenol Degradation and Tolerance in Acinetobacter lwoffii through Adaptive Evolution
pmc-10671910.creator: Nan Xu, Xiaojing Yang, Qiyuan Yang, Minliang Guo, Irina Sousa Moreira
pmc-10671910.description: Microorganism-based methods have been widely applied for the treatment of phenol-polluted environments. The previously isolated Acinetobacter lwoffii NL1 strain could completely degrade 0.5 g/L phenol within 12 h, but not higher concentrations of phenol. In this study, we developed an evolutionary strain NL115, through adaptive laboratory evolution, which possessed improved degradation ability and was able to degrade 1.

pmc-11432044.title: Zeaxanthin and Lutein Ameliorate Alzheimer’s Disease-like Pathology: Modulation of Insulin Resistance, Neuroinflammation, and Acetylcholinesterase Activity in an Amyloid-β Rat Model
pmc-11432044.creator: Da-Sol Kim, Suna Kang, Na-Rang Moon, Bae-Keun Shin, Sunmin Park, Alberto Pérez-Mediavilla
pmc-11432044.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is characterized by impaired insulin/insulin-like growth factor-1 signaling in the hippocampus. Zeaxanthin and lutein, known for their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, have been reported to protect against brain damage and cognitive decline. However, their mechanisms related to insulin signaling in AD remain unclear.

pmc-11434572.title: Cyano-Substituted Oligo(p-phenylene vinylene) Derivatives with Aggregation-Induced Enhanced Emissions and Mechanofluorochromic Luminescence
pmc-11434572.creator: Xinju Zhu, Yaru Pan, Xinran Zhao, Yu Yuan, Zewen Zhai, Xiaoni Yu, Wenjing Zhang, Yuanyuan Chang, Bing Song, Linlin Shi, Xinqi Hao, Mariana Pinteala
pmc-11434572.description: Developing red fluorescence emitters with simple structures via convenient synthetic routes is highly desirable yet challenging. Herein, two novel donor–acceptor-type red emitters, DCFOPV-TPA and SCFOPV-TPA, featuring the intramolecular charge transfer effect were designed by integrating triphenylamine and trifluoromethyl into a CN-substituted oligo(p-phenylene vinylene) backbone. Both chromophores exhibited aggregation-induced enhanced emission and solvatochromic behavior.

pmc-11532186.title: The ovarian cancer-associated microbiome contributes to the tumor’s inflammatory microenvironment
pmc-11532186.creator: Min Zhang, Jiahang Mo, Wu Huang, Yiting Bao, Xukai Luo, Lei Yuan
pmc-11532186.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A growing body of research has established a correlation between tumors and persistent chronic inflammatory infiltration. As a primary instigator of inflammation, the majority of microbiomes naturally residing within our bodies engage in a mutually beneficial symbiotic relationship. Nevertheless, alterations in the microbiome's composition or breaches in the normal barrier function can disrupt the internal environment's homeostasis, potentially leading to the development and progression of various diseases, including tumors.

pmc-11544873.title: Progress in Dentin-Derived Bone Graft Materials: A New Xenogeneic Dentin-Derived Material with Retained Organic Component Allows for Broader and Easier Application
pmc-11544873.creator: Lari Sapoznikov, Martin Humphrey
pmc-11544873.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The optimal repair of rigid mineralized tissues, such as bone, in cases of fracture, surgical resection, or prosthetic placement, is a complex process often necessitating the use of bone graft materials. Autogenous bone from the patient is generally the gold standard in terms of outcomes but also has disadvantages, which have resulted in extensive research in the field of tissue engineering to develop better and more convenient alternatives.

pmc-11672217.title: Insufficient Labor Epidural Analgesia Due to Asymptomatic Sacral Perineural Cyst: A Case Report
pmc-11672217.creator: Ryuichi Wakata, Mihou Inoue, Kyomi Kasai
pmc-11672217.description: Lumbar epidural anesthesia is widely used for labor epidural analgesia (LEA), but it often results in insufficient analgesia in the sacral region. We report a case where we performed LEA using lumbar epidural anesthesia, and an asymptomatic sacral perineural cyst was considered the potential cause of inadequate analgesia in the sacral region.

pmc-11674848.title: Construction of a Dataset for All Expressed Transcripts for Alzheimer’s Disease Research
pmc-11674848.creator: Zhenyu Huang, Bocheng Shi, Xuechen Mu, Siyu Qiao, Gangyi Xiao, Yan Wang, Ying Xu
pmc-11674848.description: Accurate identification and functional annotation of splicing isoforms and non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs), alongside full-length protein-encoding transcripts, are critical for understanding gene (mis)regulation and metabolic reprogramming in Alzheimer’s disease (AD). This study aims to provide a comprehensive and accurate transcriptome resource to improve existing AD transcript databases.

pmc-12372378.title: Leaving no one behind: the impact of disability and socioeconomic status on maternal continuum of care
pmc-12372378.creator: Ebisa Turi, Lisa Gold, Ha ND Le, Hasheem Mannan, Eric HY Lau, Julie Abimanyi-Ochom
pmc-12372378.description: BackgroundTo ensure that women with disabilities (WwD) have access to essential maternal health services, understanding their service utilization within the continuum of care (CoC) framework is vital. However, the influence of women’s disability status on maternal CoC has not been fully explored.

pmc-12513629.title: Trends and projections of the global burden of T2DM-associated CKD related to high BMI: A global burden of disease study 2021
pmc-12513629.creator: Jing Zhang, Wenxuan Li, Zhen Sun, Yunyang Wang, Yu Xue, Ke Si, Yajing Huang, Wenshan Lv, Lili Xu, Yangang Wang, Claudio Dávila-Cervantes, Claudio Dávila-Cervantes, Claudio Dávila-Cervantes, Claudio Dávila-Cervantes
pmc-12513629.description: BackgroundType 2 diabetic-associated chronic kidney disease (T2DM-Associated CKD), a leading cause of end-stage renal disease, is exacerbated by rising particularly high body mass index (BMI) rates. This study examines the global burden of T2DM-Associated CKD attributable to high BMI from 1990 to 2021 and projects future trends using the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 data.

pmc-13174274.title: Automated assessment of right ventricular systolic function from coronary angiograms with video-based artificial intelligence algorithms: development, validation, comparison against humans, and prospective deployment
pmc-13174274.creator: Fatima Zahra Fawzi, Istok Menkovic, Nicolas Dostie, Maxime Tremblay-Gravel, Marie-Claude Parent, Gabriel Asslo, Jean-François Tanguay, Guillaume Marquis-Gravel, Minhaj Ansari, Joshua P Barrios, Geoffrey H Tison, Jacques Delfrate, Robert Avram
pmc-13174274.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). AimsRight ventricular systolic function (RVSF) is a critical determinant of cardiovascular outcomes, yet assessment during coronary angiography remains challenging without prior imaging. We developed and validated DeepRV, a deep learning model predicting RVSF from routine coronary angiograms.Methods and resultsDeepRV, a video-based deep neural network, was developed using 8053 coronary angiography studies from 6923 patients at Montreal Heart Institute (2017–23), with RVSF determined by echocardiography.

pmc-13398025.title: Employing Nanotechnology to Enhance Ethanol Production in Two Synechococcus elongatus Strains
pmc-13398025.creator: Alexandra M Schirmacher, David A Russo, Alexandra C U Furch, Julie A Z Zedler
pmc-13398025.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cyanobacteria have emerged as promising photosynthetic cell factories. However, low product yields remain a bottleneck to industrial exploitation. Here, we use bacterial microcompartment technology to improve product titres using ethanol biosynthesis as the model pathway. Two strategies compared to unmodified enzyme production were tested: first, targeting enzymes to nanofilaments by fusion with encapsulation peptides (EPs) which form non‐covalent interactions with the filaments. Second, the enzyme‐EP fusions were used in the absence of nanofilaments, as EPs tend to form soluble aggregates.

pmc-13416149.title: Clinical outcomes associated with Korean medicine home-visit care for patients with cognitive impairment: a multi-center retrospective observational study
pmc-13416149.creator: Chan-Young Kwon, Jihyeon Lee, Yujin Han
pmc-13416149.description: This multi-center retrospective study investigated associations between a 4-month Korean medicine (KM) home-visit program and pain, behavioral and psychological symptoms of dementia (BPSD), cognitive function, and caregiver burden in 92 patients with cognitive impairment (Global Deterioration Scale stages 2–5) assessed at baseline, 2 months, and 4 months. Complete case analysis was the primary analytical approach.

pmc-13578542.title: Postprandial Changes in Thoracic Aortic Flow Detected by 4D Flow MRI May Influence Study Results
pmc-13578542.creator: Maren Friederike Balks, Luisa Quest, Andreas Stroth, Alexander Reiber, Patricia Ulloa, Nicolas Kirschke, Malte Maria Sieren, Joachim Graessner, Hendrik Kooijman, Jörg Barkhausen, Alex Frydrychowicz, Thekla Helene Oechtering

pmc-13600135.title: Powassan Virus in the United States: An AI-Integrative One Health Scoping Review of Ecological Drivers, Zoonotic Interactions, Symptom Profiles, and Public Health Implications
pmc-13600135.creator: Sarah P. Maxwell, Connie L. McNeely, James R. Harrington, Kevin C. Thomas
pmc-13600135.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Powassan virus (POWV) is the only tick-borne encephalitis-group flavivirus endemic to the United States (U.S.) and is an increasingly serious public health threat. cases remain relatively few but have grown steadily—from fewer than two annually before 2005 to a record 60 in 2024—and neuroinvasive disease carries a 10–15% case fatality with lasting neurological sequelae in roughly half of the survivors.

pmc-13621523.title: Autologous collagen-induced chondrogenesis versus mesenchymal stem cell therapy combined with high tibial osteotomy for medial knee osteoarthritis: a retrospective study
pmc-13621523.creator: Yun Hwan Kim, Bo Seung Bae, Jae Woong Jung, Chan Sik Kim, Seon Ae Kim, Mi-La Cho, Suo Kim, Sung Bin Sorn, Asode Ananthram Shetty, Jianmo Li, Seok Jung Kim
pmc-13621523.description: BackgroundCartilage restoration techniques combined with high tibial osteotomy (HTO) have increasingly been used to delay conversion to total knee arthroplasty. Among these, autologous collagen-induced chondrogenesis (ACIC) and mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) therapy have gained significant research attention; however, their comparative therapeutic efficacy remains unclear.
